_planNotes.scope: ONLY series #1 (the active angle). Series #2/#3 captured in campaign-knowledge.json but not planned.
_planNotes.renderPolicy: User directed render-all (--all): edits happen on rendered cards, so everything renders first, then gets approved/edited on the review page.
_planNotes.motionRatioMix: ~30% video / 5% gif / 65% static. Series #1 is a cold/warm problem-activation angle; per the playbook cold hooks sit on statics/3s clips and video shines on WARM proof + the offer + the full arc. Deliberately under the 0.6 video knob (lowest-priority constraint).
_planNotes.freshnessNote: Fresh = 5/20 (~25%), under the 0.45 floor. Fit-first overrides: the static bank is now role-ready for hook/reframe/claim. Only genuine no-fit cases are fresh — a 3s motion hook, a stat card, a credentials/proof card, an offer card, and a 30s full-arc VSL (no bank template exposes those roles/formats).
_planNotes.imageNote: krakenRoot is null AND the Kraken source is a web URL (thekraken.vercel.app) with no connector in-session. Renders use each template's placeholder media; real brand photos get placed by hand in the editor. Image-bearing assets carry `needs-kraken-path`.
_planNotes.destinationNote: Approved/rendered assets are meant to land in the user's Kraken folder (web URL). No Kraken connector is wired, so upload is a manual/after step until one is connected.
_planNotes.voice: No emoji, no exclamation points, no em dashes. Guarantee verbatim + auto-fill-locked. Address the parent.

angles.name: My kid tries hard (The Grind Trap / The Last Rep Lie)
angles.mechanism: UMP Mechanism 1 — The Velocity Drop: fatigued reps encode slowness into the nervous system like muscle memory. Fix = Principle 3, the set ends the instant speed drops 10%.
angles.emotionalJob: End the parent's guilt. It's not your kid (not lazy) and not you (not negligent) — it's the unmeasured rep. Away-From relief.
angles.voice: Head-coach-to-parent, declarative, metric-driven. No emoji / exclamation / em dash.
